values.summary_what: Grant funding to support innovation projects, premises expansion and investment in machinery that improve productivity, support business growth and create new jobs in Oldham.

Must be located in or relocating to Oldham |
Must be a trading business |
Priority given to manufacturing, construction, digital and creative, and low carbon sectors |
Must create at least one full-time job before project completion |
Must provide match funding |
Project must not commence before formal approval is received |
Project must be completed and fully paid before the programme deadline

values.summary_what: Capital grants for Isle of Wight SMEs to invest in business growth, improve productivity, overcome barriers to growth, safeguard and create jobs, and leverage private sector investment.
values.summary_who: Micro, small and medium-sized enterprises based on the Isle of Wight, including start-ups, established businesses and social enterprises.
values.summary_criteria:
Must be an SME trading on the Isle of Wight |
Must create or safeguard private sector jobs on the Isle of Wight |
Must require capital investment |
Must provide at least 50% match funding |

Planning permissions, licences and consents must be in place where required |
Projects involving leased premises must have landlord consent and at least 5 years remaining on the lease |
Funding cannot support existing working capital or revenue costs
